observations.title: Klyuchevskoy volcano (Russia)
observations.description: The Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT) reported that a thermal anomaly over Klyuchevskoy was identified in satellite images on most days during 10-15 September; weather clouds occasionally obscured views. The Aviation Color Code was lowered to Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-color scale) on 9 September. Dates are based on UTC; specific events are in local time where noted. Source: Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT)

observations.title: Bezymianny volcano (Russia)
observations.description: The Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT) reported that effusive activity at Bezymianny continued during 8-14 October. A thermal anomaly was identified in satellite images on most days; the volcano was occasionally obscured by weather clouds. Dates and times are provided in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC); events are in local time only where specified. Source: Kamchatkan Volcanic Eruption Response Team (KVERT)
